item.title: RIFTS Add-On
item.creator: Sapphire Studios
item.description:
Discover dimensional rifts hidden across your world in this Add-On. Use custom shards to unlock and battle waves of corrupted mobs! Explore floating islands, score epic loot, and craft your own portable rifts to build unique mob farms!

* Vibrant Visuals Recommended
* Portable Rifts
* Custom Items
* Custom Dungeon Structures
* Works with other Add-Ons

faqEntries.heading: What are rifts?
faqEntries.content: Rifts are gateways which mobs spawn through in a combat setup! Defeat the waves and complete the challenges to earn rewards.

faqEntries.heading: How do I find rifts in my world?
faqEntries.content: Rifts spawn naturally as Dormant Rifts on structures throughout the world.

faqEntries.heading: I found a floating island but the door is locked. How do I get in?
faqEntries.content: Search the island for a Dungeon Key hidden in chests or barrels. Use the key on the locked door to access the maze and reach the rift inside.

faqEntries.heading: How do I make a permanent Player Rift?
faqEntries.content: Throw a Rift Pearl to spawn a rift, use a Rift Cube on it, defeat the encounter, then interact with the stabilized rift. You'll receive a Player Rift item you can throw down and reactivate anywhere with a Rift Shard.

faqEntries.heading: Does this work in multiplayer?
faqEntries.content: Yes, this pack will function in multiplayer.

howToEntries.heading: The Basics:
howToEntries.content:
1.) Explore your world to discover Dormant Rifts hidden inside mysterious structures. They can appear underground, on the surface, or even floating in the sky.

2.) Collect Rift Shards by mining glowing Resonant Crystal formations found near rift structures. These shards are your key to activating rifts.

3.) Hold a Rift Shard and interact with a Dormant Rift to activate it. Prepare for a fight: waves of corrupted mobs will emerge from the portal.

4.) Survive all waves and defeat the final boss to earn powerful rewards, including items that unlock higher-tier challenges and new ways to use rifts.

5.) There are 5 rift tiers with increasing difficulty and better loot. Start with Common Rifts and work your way up as you grow stronger.

6.) Some structures require exploration to access. Search your surroundings carefully for hidden items that open locked areas.
